remarks: Cosmopolitan lifestyle at its best! Open loft penthouse end unit in the heart of South Norwalk. Have your guests join you for sunset on the rooftop deck before you head out to the plethora of restaurants, bars and entertainment in the neighborhood including a movie theatre and the SONO Collection mall. The unit itself has soaring ceilings, gorgeous wood floors, new gas range and dryer and a recently updated full bath - nothing to do here but move in! Floor to ceiling windows bring in an abundance of light that illuminates the large kitchen with an oversized island and stainless steel counters. And, although you can walk to countless places, there is also plenty of room for your car in the attached, covered parking garage for days when you want to go out of town or to the nearby beaches. This elegant and stately condo is also in walking distance to the Metro North train for easy in and out of NYC. Come celebrate the rest of your summer in style!
